fields.description: Default company for Accommodation Ledger, Maintenance, Utility, and Lease documents. Required before enabling financial posting.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Operational currency for Habitat cost fields. Fetched from Company if left blank.
fields.label: Default Currency

fields.description: Default mode keeps all custody and depreciation inside Habitat with no financial posting.
fields.label: Custody Integration Mode
fields.options:
Habitat Internal / No Financial Posting
ERPNext Asset Integration
ERPNext Stock Integration

fields.label: Auto-create Facility Asset Movement on Transfer

fields.description: Housing office contact number shown to workers on the Masar home My Contacts card.
fields.label: Housing Office Number

fields.description: When OFF, Accommodation Ledger rows are operational memos with no GL impact.
fields.label: Enable GL Entry Posting

fields.description: How long machine-written time-series records are kept before the daily log cleanup purges old rows. Blank or 0 falls back to the built-in default for that record. Financial ledgers are never auto-purged.
fields.label: Data Retention

fields.description: Retention for daily occupancy and weekly vehicle-utilisation snapshots (days). Default 365.
fields.label: Snapshot Retention (Days)

fields.description: Retention for submitted Operational Depreciation Snapshots (days). Default 730.
fields.label: Depreciation Snapshot Retention (Days)

fields.description: Which payment DocType the Pay action creates and how Salis Payment Request fields map onto it. This routes the payment record only; General Ledger posting stays governed by Enable GL Entry Posting.
fields.label: Target Payment Document

fields.description: The payment DocType the Create Payment action builds (for example Payment Entry, Payment Order, or a client's custom payment DocType). Leave blank to use the native Payment Request, the default target. A Single settings record or a child table is refused: neither can be created as a standalone payment.
fields.label: Target Payment DocType

fields.description: When checked and the target DocType is submittable, the router submits the created payment document. Default off (leave the payment in Draft for review).
fields.label: Auto-submit Target Payment
Field Map Help
fields.options: Each row sets one field on the target payment document. For a normal mapping, give the Target Fieldname (on the target DocType) and the Source Fieldname to copy from the Salis Payment Request (for example amount, supplier, company, cost_center, project, remarks). Check Static to write a constant Static Value instead (for example a fixed payment_type or party_type).

fields.description: Mapping rows applied in order. Each: target field = static value (when Static) else the value of the source field on the request.
fields.label: Field Map

fields.description: Turn the building-store engine off to stop every custody and material posting at once.
fields.label: Enable Stock Engine

fields.description: Refuse a posting whose building is not an open store.
fields.label: Require An Active Store

fields.description: Off, a posting that would drive a store or a holder below zero is refused.
fields.label: Allow Negative Stock

fields.description: How many days back a posting may be dated. Zero means today only.
fields.label: Backdating Days

fields.description: The one role allowed to post further back than the window above.
fields.label: Backdating Role

fields.description: Nothing posts on or before this date, whatever the window allows.
fields.label: Stock Frozen Upto

fields.description: Blocks every email this app would send, including its own Notification alerts, whatever those alerts are set to. Leave OFF until the site's outgoing email (SMTP) is configured. Turning it ON does not switch any alert on by itself — it stops holding them back, and each alert still sends only if it is enabled. Email from other apps on this site is not affected.
fields.label: Enable Email Notifications

fields.description: When ON, expiry/overdue scheduler jobs post a timeline comment on the source document. Email is controlled by the Notification DocType. When OFF, jobs run silently.
fields.label: Enable Operational Notifications

fields.description: Days before a Building License expiry date to flag it Expiring Soon (per-license renewal_lead_days still overrides).
fields.label: License Expiry Lead Days

fields.description: Days before a building lease end date to flag it on the watchlist.
fields.label: Lease Expiry Lead Days

fields.description: Days before a temporary stay's expected check-out date to flag it on the supervisor's watchlist.
fields.label: Temporary Stay Lead Days

fields.description: Email that receives the Safety Round report when a safety checklist round is submitted. If empty, the report goes to the Accommodation Manager(s).
fields.label: Safety Report Recipient

fields.description: Days before a safety task's due date to send a pre-due reminder.
fields.label: Safety Pre-Due Lead Days

fields.description: Grace days after the due date before a safety task is flagged Overdue.
fields.label: Safety Overdue Grace Days

fields.description: When ON, the weekly coverage gate requires every building to be covered by a safety round.
fields.label: Require Weekly All-Building Coverage

fields.description: When ON, transferring externally-purchased goods into custody requires a one-time password confirmed by the receiving supervisor.
fields.label: Require Handover OTP

fields.description: Minutes a handover one-time password stays valid before it expires.
fields.label: Handover OTP Validity (Minutes)

fields.description: Apply an operational markup to external-supplier accommodation costs in the Supplier Cost Recovery report.
fields.label: Enable Supplier Markup

fields.description: Send a memo-only notification to Finance when a Material Transfer moves stock between buildings on different cost centers. No GL Entry is posted.
fields.label: Notify Finance on Liability Transfer

fields.description: Recipient address for the cross-cost-center transfer memo. Falls back to the Finance Manager role if left blank.
fields.label: Finance Notification Email

fields.description: When ON, the Arrivals Desk register sheet offers a camera capture that reads a passport's machine-readable zone (MRZ) and pre-fills the name, passport number, nationality, and expiry. Requires an OCR engine to be available on the bench (see docs). When OFF (default) or when OCR is unavailable, manual entry is used.
fields.label: Enable Passport MRZ OCR Autofill
